Definition: probably from the same as G726; properly, a headache (as a seizure of pain) from drunkenness, i.e. (by implication) a debauch (by analogy, a glut):--surfeiting.
BiblicalUsage: Surfeiting is the heavy, sick feeling after too much drink and too much food, and it appears once, in Jesus' warning in Luke 21:34: take heed lest your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting and drunkenness and the cares of this life, so that the day comes upon you unawares.
TheologicalSignificance: I am sure Jesus put surfeiting beside drunkenness and daily worry for a reason: a dulled heart is as dangerous as a drunk one, and both miss the day when it comes.
